metadata.title: Harmonic torsion of algebraic generalized Ricci solitons and the structure of solvable extensions
metadata.abstract: We prove harmonicity for nonshrinking algebraic generalized Ricci solitons and for all algebraic generalized Ricci solitons on solvable Lie algebras. In the solvable setting, we characterize expanding solitons by normal extensions of generalized nilsolitons, and derive a sharp rank bound.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 广义 Ricci soliton 的 harmonic torsion 与扩张
analysis.workSummary: 证明 solvable 上非 shrinking algebraic generalized Ricci soliton 的 torsion 调和；将 expanding 情形刻画为 generalized nilsoliton 的 normal extension，并给扩张秩的锐界。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一 torsion 调和性与可解扩张的结构。
analysis.limitations: 调和性限于指定 algebraic 与非 shrinking 条件；expanding 的结构刻画有单独假设。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT Astra 与 Codex 在作者指导下用于数学探索、起草、文献检索及内部审查，作者核验数学论证和文献并负责。
